title: Relax bilayer CCPS in AFE+AFM ground state
action: Starting from the published crystal structure of CuCrP2S6, construct a bilayer supercell with the stripe-antiferroelectric (AFE) ordering of Cu+ ions and interlayer antiferromagnetic (AFM) alignment of Cr spins. Perform a full DFT relaxation of the atomic positions (keeping lattice vectors fixed) until forces are converged. Write the relaxed structure.
description: Reference geometry for all subsequent Cu-displacement and magnetic-energy calculations.

title: Compute total energy of 2L-mAFE-I metastable state
action: From the relaxed ground state, displace one anti-parallel Cu-ion stripe in the bottom monolayer toward the van der Waals interface to create the 2L-mAFE-I configuration. Perform a single-point DFT energy calculation to obtain its total energy, verifying that it is a metastable state and providing the endpoint structure for the CINEB path.
description: Defines the final configuration for the Cu-ion displacement pathway.

title: Run CINEB to find Cu-ion displacement path
action: Using the climbing-image nudged elastic band (CINEB) method, connect the relaxed AFE ground state and the 2L-mAFE-I state with a chain of intermediate images. Extract the relaxed intermediate geometries and record the Cu displacement Δd (distance of the moving Cu ions from their ground-state positions) for each image, ensuring the path samples the key displacements Δd = 0.29, 0.44, 1.0, 1.69 Å.
description: Provides the set of structures along the displacement coordinate needed for ΔE_MEC evaluation.

title: Compute magnetoelectric coupling energy change ΔE_MEC(Δd)
action: For each structure from the CINEB path with Cu displacement Δd = 0, 0.29, 0.44, 1.0, 1.69 Å, perform two total-energy DFT calculations: one with the interlayer spin alignment set to ferromagnetic (FM') and one set to antiferromagnetic (AFM). From these, compute ΔE_MEC(Δd) = (E_FM'(Δd) − E_AFM(Δd)) − (E_FM'(0) − E_AFM(0)). Write the results as a comma-separated table with header Δd (Å) and ΔE_MEC (meV/UC) to energy_potential.csv.
description: Stores the magnetoelectric coupling energy change at the key Cu displacements; the monotonic decrease is the main target.
output_schema: Columns: Δd (Å, float), ΔE_MEC (meV/UC, float). Comma-separated with header. Must contain exactly the five rows Δd = 0, 0.29, 0.44, 1.0, 1.69.

title: Compute net majority spin on bridging S atoms
action: From the DFT charge density of the ground-state structure (Δd=0) and the intermediate structure with Δd=0.44 Å (AFM spin configuration), extract the net majority spin on the bridging S atoms (integral of spin density summed over the p orbitals of the S atoms that mediate the interlayer coupling). Write the two values to charge_analysis.txt as 'S_spin_polarization_d0: <value> e-/S' and 'S_spin_polarization_d044: <value> e-/S'.
description: Spin polarization on the bridging S atoms, which rationalizes the reduction of superexchange.
